name: ASM-017 compact drawer slide-latch assembly benchmark
description: Intermediate hierarchical CAD assembly benchmark for a compact drawer slide with cabinet rail, drawer rail, center slide cage, rollers, ball bearings, latch hook, release tab, stops, and screws.

tasks.prompt: Create a compact drawer slide and latch assembly with fixed cabinet rail, moving drawer rail, center slide cage, roller wheels, ball bearings, latch hook, release tab, stop bumpers, and repeated mounting screws. Use simple robust primitives.
assumptions: Intermediate appliance/transport-style benchmark uses nested rail modules and repeated rollers/balls for assembly hierarchy.
Repeated bearings, rollers, screws, and bumpers are intentionally large enough to avoid fragile CAD details.
Generated STEP, GLB, topology, and component artifacts are produced by the CAD benchmark pipeline and are not hand-edited source of truth.
